mentions.note: aged 21, won the Irish Cross Country Championships at Ennis by 20 seconds, 27 February 1977
fastest ever Belgravian at 3,000m, 7th in 7:59.1 at Crystal Palace 18 May 1977; won 5,000m for Ireland v Greece at Limerick in 13:57.0
